result:
All 617 tests pass. The fixes made:

1. **`src/components/domain/search/query-syntax.ts`** — added `explicitKinds` so callers can distinguish "typed `kind:`" from "no token at all."
2. **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`** — now uses the shared `parseSearchQuery` (one parser, rule 5) instead of rejecting any query containing a colon; enforces issues-only when `advanced_search` is off; honors `kind:`/`project:` tokens; `indexComment` now looks up the issue's `projectId` so comments are scoped correctly; the `search.reindex_requested` listener now handles `comment` and `project` kinds (previously issue-only) and drops archived subjects instead of re-adding them.
3. **`src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts`** — escapes `%`, `_`, and `\` before building the `LIKE` pattern (with an explicit `ESCAPE` clause) so literal matching actually is literal.
4. **`src/components/domain/search/search-dialog.tsx`** — palette now requests issues+comments+projects by default when `advanced_search` is on (not just issues), unless an explicit `kind:`/`in:` token says otherwise.
5. **`src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/search/page.tsx`** — corrected the plan-name text to match the actual `enterprise` gate.
